messages:
Oliver: heads-up — saw 3 nodes in eu-west with Xid 13 + ECC errors in last 24h. investigation stuck because logs live across dmesg, journalctl, and nvidia-smi. can we standardize an ingest? :thinking_face:
Maya: yeah, those are noisy. current workflow: devx runs `journalctl -k -u nvidia-persistenced` + `dmesg --ctime | grep -i -E 'NVRM|Xid'` and then we dump `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION -i <GPU>`... painful to correlate.
Ken: +1. also missing PCI slot and current driver module version in our log events. we need a canonical key: host, pci_addr, gpu_index, timestamp, xid_code, ecc_count, driver_version, nvml_ret
infra-bot: autoparsed: created alert rule `gpu.xid.spike` (threshold: 3 xid errors per 10m) for eu-* clusters
Oliver: proposal: ship a single \"gpu-system\" event from each node that aggregates parse results from journalctl/dmesg/nvidia-smi every 30s. fields: `host`, `ts`, `pci_addr`, `xid_codes[]`, `last_ecc_counts`, `nvidia_smi_summary`.
Maya: sketch of logshipper config:
```yaml
- type: exec
  name: gpu-agg
  interval: 30s
  command: |
    /usr/local/bin/gpu-agg-collector --output-json
```

Example emitted doc:
```json
{\"host\":\"node-123\",\"ts\":\"2026-02-12T03:21:45Z\",\"pci\":\"0000:3b:00.0\",\"xids\":[13],\"ecc\":{\"corrected\":4,\"uncorrected\":1},\"nvsmi\":{\"temp\":84,\"mem_used_mb\":12000}}
```
Ken: love it. make `xids` normalized to integers and include raw dmesg snippet for quick triage. size cap 1kb.
Maya: suggested parser regex for dmesg: `(?P<pci>0000:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2}\.[0-9])\\s+NVRM: Xid\\s+(?P<xid>\\d+):`
Oliver: also add an enrichment step that queries `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` and includes `attached_pod` label from kubelet for hosts in k8s.
oncall: if we standardize, can we trigger an automated drain suggestion? i'd like a `drain_score` field (0-100) computed from xid frequency + uncorrected_ecc + driver age.
Maya: yes — initial heuristic: drain_score = min(100, xid_rate*20 + uncorrected_ecc*30 + driver_age_months*2)
Ken: Ops: implement parser + an alert in Loki/ES mapping. I'll open a PR for collector and a Kibana mapping for `gpu-system-*` indices.
Oliver: action items: Ken -> PR for collector (eta 2d), Maya -> add regexes + unit tests (eta 1d), Oncall -> draft runbook update for `gpu failure fast-attr` (eta 1d). infra-bot: annotate runbook when done.
infra-bot: ack: task created #INFR-827
oncall: thanks. also can we add a quick `kubectl` one-liner for triage? e.g.,
```bash
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-123
```
Maya: added note: remember to scrub tenant metadata for hosted logs. redact pod names with `redact_pod` filter in shipper.
Ken: will test on canary pool tonight. please @oncall if you see a noisy flood.
Oliver: perfect — lets keep messages short, good pattern to roll out across regions. :rocket:
